newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle market not tested - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle market not tested - USDA.

text.p: Trade at a standstill in the Panhandle Monday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers not tested. Feedlots reporting moderate inquiry from buyers.
There were 4,400 head confirmed for the week to date. The last established price was $67.00 per cwt on Friday. Monday's packer bid was $66.00, with asking prices $68.00-$69.00.
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
Confirmed - None Week Ago - None Year Ago - 2,400
